XMLDB.COMMENT: AI Grader quiz report plugin tables

TABLE.NAME: quiz_aigrader_attempt_ctx
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores attempt context for consistent grading across attempts

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question ID being graded

FIELD.NAME: attemptnum
FIELD.COMMENT: Which attempt number

FIELD.NAME: criteriamet
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of criterion IDs that were met

FIELD.NAME: feedbacksummary
FIELD.COMMENT: Summary of last feedback for consistency

FIELD.NAME: lastgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Last APPROVED grade as a percentage, written by the assessor's approval - not the AI's suggestion

FIELD.NAME: aigrade
FIELD.COMMENT: Last grade the AI suggested, as a percentage, kept separate from the approved grade

FIELD.NAME: aicriteriamet
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of criterion IDs the AI last reported, before assessor confirmation

FIELD.NAME: aifeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: The AI feedback as issued for the current suggestion, before site policy filtering or assessor edits

FIELD.NAME: aicriteria
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON record of what the current suggestion was measured against: mode, source, fingerprint and the criteria shown

FIELD.NAME: suggestedtime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the current suggestion was issued, used to enforce the minimum review time server-side

FIELD.NAME: humanreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Flagged for human review - approval requires an explicit assessor acknowledgement

FIELD.NAME: autolocked
FIELD.COMMENT: Competency established on an earlier attempt - advisory only, never awards a mark

TABLE.NAME: quiz_aigrader_grading_logs
TABLE.COMMENT: Logs each essay grading event for time tracking

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz that was graded

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course containing the quiz

FIELD.NAME: graderid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who approved the grade

FIELD.NAME: qubaid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question usage by activity ID

FIELD.NAME: slot
FIELD.COMMENT: Question slot number

FIELD.NAME: timegraded
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when grade was approved

TABLE.NAME: quiz_aigrader_decisions
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only record of every assessment decision: what the AI suggested, what the assessor approved, and whether they differed

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner whose work was assessed

FIELD.NAME: graderid
FIELD.COMMENT: The assessor who approved this decision

FIELD.NAME: maxmark
FIELD.COMMENT: The question's maximum mark at the time of the decision

FIELD.NAME: aimark
FIELD.COMMENT: The mark the AI suggested, null when no suggestion was issued

FIELD.NAME: finalmark
FIELD.COMMENT: The mark the assessor approved and that was written to the gradebook

FIELD.NAME: markchanged
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the assessor changed the suggested mark

FIELD.NAME: feedbackchanged
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the assessor edited the suggested feedback

FIELD.NAME: aifeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: The AI feedback as issued, before any site policy filtering or assessor edit

FIELD.NAME: finalfeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: The feedback the learner received

FIELD.NAME: criteriamet
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of criterion IDs recorded against this decision

FIELD.NAME: policymode
FIELD.COMMENT: The full-marks feedback policy in force when this decision was made

FIELD.NAME: graderinfohash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the criteria the decision was made against

FIELD.NAME: criteriasource
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the criteria came from: graderinfo, questiontext, generalfeedback, extracted, inferred or none

FIELD.NAME: instructionshash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the extra AI instructions in force

FIELD.NAME: modelversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Model or prompt version reported by the grading service

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: Grading service request identifier, for tracing a decision back to its suggestion

FIELD.NAME: reviewseconds
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds between the suggestion being issued and the assessor approving it

FIELD.NAME: humanreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this decision was made under a human-review flag

FIELD.NAME: autolocked
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether competency had already been established on an earlier attempt

FIELD.NAME: acknowledgement
FIELD.COMMENT: The assessor's stated reason, required when approving under a human-review flag

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the schedule

FIELD.NAME: frequency
FIELD.COMMENT: daily, weekly, or monthly

FIELD.NAME: recipients
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated email addresses to CC

FIELD.NAME: lastrun
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of last email sent

FIELD.NAME: nextrun
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of next scheduled run

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether schedule is active

FIELD.NAME: format
FIELD.COMMENT: excel or pdf

TABLE.NAME: quiz_aigrader_criteria
TABLE.COMMENT: Marking criteria an assessor confirmed for a question at a mark in a quiz. Only confirmed criteria drive the per-criterion breakdown

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question version the criteria were confirmed for

FIELD.NAME: criteria
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of the confirmed criteria, each with label and max

FIELD.NAME: maxmark
FIELD.COMMENT: The question's mark in the quiz when confirmed; the criteria add up to it

FIELD.NAME: fieldshash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the question text, Information for graders, General feedback and default mark when confirmed

FIELD.NAME: proposedsource
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the plugin found the criteria it proposed: graderinfo, questiontext, generalfeedback or none

FIELD.NAME: confirmedby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who confirmed the criteria

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: reviewed: confirmed in the editor; bulk: confirmed with other exact readings in one action
